source: export function verify(run) { const r=run(); return r.error || r.status !== 0 ? 1 : 0; }
intent: The verifier must return nonzero on child failure/timeout and zero on success.

source: export function accept(report, latest) { return report.source === latest.source && report.attempt === latest.attempt && report.status === 'PASS' && latest.status === 'PASS'; }
intent: Review this bounded receipt admission function only. It must admit a matching latest PASS and reject mismatched source/attempt or a failed latest attempt. Other report validation occurs upstream.

source: export function readGame(game, teacherId) { return {title:game.title,teacherId:game.teacherId}; }
intent: Review only this access helper. A game title is private teacher data; only its owning teacher may receive it. Unauthenticated or different owners must be denied before data is returned.

source: export function readGame(game, teacherId) { if(!teacherId || teacherId!==game.teacherId)return null; return {title:game.title}; }
intent: Review only this access helper. Only the owner may read the private title; null is the documented denied result. Authentication and storage happen upstream; do not invent other requirements.

source: export function replaceGame(store,id,next) { store.delete(id); if(!next.title)throw new Error('Invalid title'); store.set(id,next); }
intent: Review only replacement of a previously saved game. Invalid edits must be rejected while preserving the existing game. The supplied Map is the authoritative store for this bounded function; there is no surrounding rollback.

source: export function pageCount(total,size) { return Math.floor(total/size); }
intent: Review page-count display for an optional archived-game list. Inputs are validated positive integer size and nonnegative total. Every nonempty partial final page must be reachable; data remains stored, and individual-game access and editing still work. This affects list pagination only.

source: export function attemptLoad(load,retries) { for(let i=0;i<retries;i++){const result=load();if(result.ok)return result;}return {ok:false}; }
intent: Review optional read-only metadata loading. retries means additional attempts AFTER one initial attempt, including an initial call when retries=0. A final failure is handled with a visible fallback and does not delete data or bypass access checks. Focus on the bounded retry contract.

source: export function completionLabel(name) { return 'Completed: '+name+'..'; }
intent: Review user-facing completion copy only. The specified text is 'Completed: <name>.' with exactly one final period. The import has already succeeded; this label does not control its execution, stored data or status.

source: export function attemptLoad(load,retries) { for(let i=0;i<=retries;i++){const result=load();if(result.ok)return result;}return {ok:false}; }
intent: Review only this read-only retry helper. Validated retries is a nonnegative integer counting additional attempts after the initial attempt; return immediately on success, return {ok:false} after exhaustion. Backoff is deliberately not required here.

source: export function namesForDisplay(names) { return [...names].sort(); }
intent: Review only display sorting of validated ASCII string names. Return ascending order without mutating the input list. Locale collation, authorization and persistence are outside this function's stated responsibility.

source: export function mayRelease(report) { return report.status !== 'FAIL'; }
intent: Review the only mandatory release admission decision in this bounded case. A release may be allowed only for status PASS. BLOCKED, FAIL and missing status must deny it. This predicate's boolean is the documented admission decision; executing an actual release is outside scope and forbidden.

source: export function pageLabel(page,total) { return page===1?'First':page===total?'Last':'Middle'; }
intent: Review only user-facing label copy. Validated positive integers identify the current page and total. The specified single-page label is 'Only', otherwise First/Last/Middle. The label never controls navigation, access, data or page count; it is cosmetic text only.

source: export function shouldWarn(duration,limit) { return duration>limit; }
intent: Review an optional editor performance-warning helper only. Validated nonnegative duration must warn at or above the positive limit, not only above it. It controls a diagnostic warning; it is NOT a security, certification or data guard. All editor operations remain available independently of this result.

source: export function mayRelease(report) { return report.status==='PASS' && report.executed===true; }
intent: Review this bounded mandatory admission decision only. Allow exactly an executed PASS report; reject not-executed, BLOCKED, FAIL or missing fields. Signature/source validation occurs upstream and is out of scope. No actual release operation is authorized or required.
